english: What had I packed before I left?

czech: Co jsi dokončil, než jsi odešel?
english: What had you finished before you left?

czech: Co už snědl, než jsme dorazili?
english: What had he eaten before we arrived?
Who had she called before she left?

czech: Co požár poškodil, než ho uhasili?
english: What had the fire damaged before they put it out?

czech: Na co jsme zapomněli, než jsme odjeli?
english: What had we forgotten before we left?
What had you seen before you arrived?

czech: Kam už odešli, když jsem jim zavolal?
english: Where had they gone by the time I called them?
